retrievalProfile.description: A high-key studio portrait framed by oversized glowing neon typography and diagonal motion-blur backgrounds for a modern celebrity aesthetic.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required
vintage or retro film grain is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered medium-shot portrait of a smiling individual against a bright, diagonally-streaked background. The composition is anchored by a large, glowing neon-style title in the upper half and clean, sans-serif metadata in the lower-left corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Oversized neon title framing the subject's head
Diagonal background lines echoing the angle of the neon letters
High-key lighting on the subject matching the brightness of the neon glow
Color coordination between the subject's attire and the warm gold accents
coreInvariants: Neon tube effect with outer glow
Clean studio lighting with soft shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, medium shot from the waist up, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large neon 'V' shape in the upper left provides the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright neon title down to the subject's face, then to the informational text in the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: High-key white and gold negative space with diagonal motion streaks creates a sense of energy.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Bright white and pale gold background streaks.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal or black for secondary text readability.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant gold neon glow and soft pink in the subject's clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (brightness) throughout with selective saturation in the neon and clothing.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and rounded tube-like forms.
letterConstructionRules: Double-line outline to simulate glass neon tubes
Rounded terminals on all neon elements
Outer glow effect in a warm yellow-gold hue
Perspective tilt following the diagonal background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'the' nested inside the larger letterforms
Exaggerated scale for the initial letter of the main title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A decorative, glowing neon display face paired with a clean, functional geometric sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, geometric structure of the metadata text.
Provides the base skeleton for the display title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio portrait of a person in a pink blazer against a white background with gold diagonal motion-blur streaks. Leave the top half clear for large text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large neon-style title in the top half using a double-line gold outline with a soft outer glow. Add left-aligned uppercase metadata in the bottom-left corner using a bold geometric sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the neon glow consistent across all letters?
Does the background motion blur follow a consistent diagonal angle?
Is the metadata text in the bottom left legible against the background?
Is the subject's lighting bright and high-key?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the neon text appears to be 'glowing' onto the subject's hair/shoulders.
Verify the diagonal background lines do not intersect the subject's face awkwardly.
Check that the corner banner is perfectly aligned to the top-left edge.
Confirm the color palette remains limited to gold, pink, and white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Diagonal Motion Background + Neon Outline Display Type + Geometric Sans Metadata
